supplemental_screens.title: Mutual adult relationship links
supplemental_screens.server_permissions: Tele Tena Patient role and matching patient profile required. Invitation token alone is insufficient. Each participant sees only the other chosen display name; no clinical record, appointment, note, balance or call grant.
supplemental_screens.workflow_transitions: No link → invitation pending → accepted/declined/expired/revoked; accepted → active relationship → revoked. Both adults attest separately. Invitations expire after a configurable demonstration default.

states.loading: Skeleton for own relationships and invitation preview.
states.empty: Explain no link exists and offer create invitation.
states.error: Show actionable invite/session/permission/network feedback; preserve confirmation state.
states.success: Confirm persisted invitation, acceptance, decline, withdrawal or revocation.

supplemental_screens.responsive_accessibility: Responsive patient workspace and invitation card; keyboard-operable consent checkbox, copy and revoke controls; verify 320/390/768/1440 CSS px and 200% zoom.

localization.translation_status: English source; Amharic/Afaan Oromo provisional pending human review.

dependencies: medical/legal review of adult-attestation and consent text
future participant-specific appointment, disclosure, call and note workflows
